answer: One concrete defense is sequential entropy chaining: at registration each agent commits a high-entropy seed hashed into an onyx-sealed commitment. Every epoch it must extend a public quartz hash-chain using that seed plus the epoch seed. Verification is sequential and non-parallelizable across identities without shared seeds, which correlation checks detect. A farm generating independent high-quality entropy for thousands of identities incurs real RNG and sequential compute cost that scales linearly, exposing the fable that identities are free.
